results.rationale: The outer frame and three given shapes remain consistent. A square appears at lower right, but it still has a central cross and a separate right-pointing chevron, rather than the required plain undivided square. The line diagram is clean and legible; the retained internal lines contradict the supplied pattern explanation.

The road gains a deep jagged central fissure, branching cracks and displaced pavement edges, fully depicting earthquake damage and the stated deformation. Guardrail, streetlights, trees and mountain composition remain consistent, with slight hillside texture variation. Crack depth, perspective and asphalt texture are visually convincing without noticeable artifacts.
